APO 500
9 June 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Expansion of Radiotelegraph Service from Japan to Siam, Hong Kong and Macau, via Mania.
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (9 Apr 48)CCS, SCAPIN 1707/3, dated 9 April 1948, subject as above
2. That part of inclosure 1 of reference memorandum showing radiotelegraph rates and division of revenue per word for full rate messages from Japan to Siam is rescinded and replaced by inclosure 1 of this memorandum.
3. Direct communication between the Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and the Ministry of Communications, concerning matters within the scope of this memorandum, is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
